findings.before: A synchronous cancelScope failure left pending status pending, busy true and retry false.
findings.after: Cancellation is best-effort and clears durable pending; disposal closes repository in finally. Root expanded its controlled transaction suite for sync/async cleanup failures.

findings.before: After cleanup was handled, cancel cleared pending but send kept sending=true until a noncooperative provider returned.
findings.after: A per-send ownership token releases the send lock before inference; an abort-racing reply promise settles without requiring provider cooperation. Independently checked old send settlement, immediately unlocked controller and late old response while a retry remains busy.

findings.before: Storing a strict-on spelling note by incrementing learner revision would invalidate chosen meaning/personal note even though learner text stayed unchanged.
findings.after: Strict-on note is stored only on partner. Learner current revision, chosen senses and personal notes remain unchanged. Strict-off actual display rewrite advances revision and preserves historical original.
